english:
Being within 15 meters of 3 or more enemies grants the 'Biotic Enhancements' buff for 5 seconds.

Biotic Enhancements grants <pve 165% /> <pvp [100%] /> additional Base Melee Damage.

Less effective with <arc Lightning Surge /> against Players.
